On Monday, former finance director Catherine Hartesvelt sued Board Chair Steve Yoder , claiming he falsely accused her of taking part in a conspiracy to conceal financial corruption. On Thursday, Rio Risbridger, who succeeded Hartesvelt in the job, filed a lawsuit in the 13th Circuit Court against Commissioner Rick Robbins. Blake Ringsmuth of Ringsmuth Wuori PLLC represents both women.
